text: Added a hover target to each activity bar in `packages/ui/src/Timeline.tsx`, since nothing on the timeline explained them. Hovering a slice now shows its event count and time range (e.g. "6 events, 09:35:34 AM to 09:39:34 AM") and darkens the bar, and an "activity" legend next to the axis start time explains the bars on hover (styles in `packages/ui/src/styles.css`). The build passed, a headless browser check found 94 slots with titles, and the change is committed as 2cf3b68 without being pushed.
